messages:
jia: Quick catch during QA — API ref rate-limiting example shows `Retry-After: 1000` in the curl response (implies ms) but per RFC it's seconds. This caused confusion in the SDK snippets. :eyes:

miguel: ah, good catch. which page? link?

jia: https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/rate-limits (line around the curl sample)

jia: sample from docs:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 1000
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "rate_limited"
}
```
This reads like 1000 seconds.

ana: yikes — our python client test expects an int seconds header, so CI failed when trying to backoff. I'll update SDK parsing to be defensive. Suggest we change docs to `Retry-After: 1` or `Retry-After: 120` and add a note: 'units are seconds'.

sam: Could we also add a tiny helper in the snippets showing normalization? e.g.: 
```
# normalize Retry-After header
h = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
if h is None:
    wait = 60
else:
    if h.endswith('ms'):
        wait = int(h[:-2]) / 1000
    else:
        wait = float(h)
```

miguel: plan: I'll open a docs PR to fix the curl/response examples to use seconds, add the note, and run a grep for `Retry-After` examples to update. Ana, can you add a small SDK change to normalize headers? Link back to the docs PR in your SDK PR.

ana: yes. I'll add a tiny helper and update tests. I'll also add a comment in the SDK changelog about 'Retry-After units clarified'.

jia: I added a failing test in QA that caught this; created issue #245 and attached failing run. I'll post the CI link in the PR.

miguel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/678 — fixes examples, adds explanatory sentence. Pinged @ana for SDK change.

ana: opened SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/210 — normalizes header and has unit tests. Added a small note in README.

doc-bot: Docs CI for PR 678: ✅ — links updated, lints passed. 

sam: nice. can we also add a one-line "compat" note under the rate-limits page: 'Some intermediaries may send ms; SDKs normalize common variants.'

miguel: added that in the PR. :shipit:

jia: closing QA ticket once both PRs merge. thanks everyone!
